column1: # Sweeps --slope in {30,40,50,60,70} riding the current compiled defaults
# (floor=80, clsselectp=15, min_weight=10, oldestsource=1). slope is the
# transfer gradient in /1000 units, so these are 0.03..0.07 -- far gentler than
# the compiled default of 500 (0.5). Each transfer is slope/1000*(src_w-80):
# smaller slope = much smaller per-transfer donations (the floor is unchanged at
# 80, only the steepness drops). Probes whether near-flat transfers help.
